subject: Locked out - long story
body: Okay, this is a bit of a saga. I use a password manager and last week I switched to a new one and imported everything. This morning the Larkspur password didn't work, so I tried the old one, then a couple of variations, then the new one again, and my colleague also tried from her laptop because she thought she knew it. Now there's a message saying the account is locked. I also got an email from you about unlocking, which I almost deleted because I thought it was phishing. I honestly don't know which password is right anymore. We have a client survey going out at noon and I need to edit the intro text before then. What's the fastest way back in? Do I have to wait for someone at Larkspur to unlock it manually?

subject: Refunding a customer who paid through my form
body: One of my customers paid a $120 deposit through my booking form and has now cancelled. Can you refund her from your side? She paid by card through the Stripe payment field.

subject: you broke my payment forms
body: After I switched to the cheaper plan last week, my deposit form stopped working completely. People just get told the form isn't accepting responses. I didn't ask you to break my payment form, I just wanted to pay less! How do I get it working on the plan I have now?
